sources.label: Патчи Morphe для российских Android-приложений
sources.author: RU Apps
patch_list: Block deep midroll ads
Disables the dedicated request_midroll runnable, midpoint configuration, and direct named midroll starts.
Block midroll ads
Stops the runtime MIDROLL branch before VideoAutoPlay pauses or switches the main video player to the instream ad engine.
Bypass native signature check
Prevents libvkcore.so from terminating re-signed VK Video builds at startup.
Disable ad pixel tracking
Stops PixelStatsTrackerImpl from sending individual and batch ad pixels.
Disable ad-free subscription promo
Disables VK's VIDEO_AD_FREE_SUBSCRIPTION feature gate so profile promo items are never created.
Disable analytics libraries
Disables runtime analytics tracking calls and initializers (AppMetrica, MyTracker, Firebase).
Disable analytics manifest components
Disables analytics and tracking components and metadata in AndroidManifest.xml.
Disable AppsFlyer

Disables AppsFlyer attribution/tracking: no-ops its SDK implementation's start() choke point (the actual activation entry point, called directly from app code — not manifest-gated in the v6+ SDK) and disables its install-referrer manifest…
Disable in-app update
Disables the VK Video in-app update check and update prompt.
Disable OpenTelemetry APM
Disables the ru.ok.tracer/OpenTelemetry pipeline (OkHttp request interception, CPU/network tech-stats, span/metric/log upload) by forcing its tracing-enabled gate off.
Disable video ad repository
Replaces the real video advertising repository with VK's built-in no-op STUB.
Disable VK Video advertising ID
Removes the advertising ID permission so ad SDKs cannot read the device's real advertising identifier.
Disable VK Video MyTarget SDK
Disables MyTarget's auto-init content provider and ad activity so the SDK never starts.
Filter clip feed ads
Removes server-provided StaticAd, MarketAd, FloatingAd, and MyTarget ad items before the VK Clips feed mapper can render them.
Filter Clips SDK ads
Drops client-side Clips SDK ad videos plus StaticAds/MarketAds before they enter the rendered feed.
Fix install conflict with stock VK
Allows the re-signed VK Video build to coexist with the official VK app.
Hide ad XML surfaces
Collapses known catalog, video-banner, and player ad layouts while preserving their XML structure.
Hide home showcase ads
Replaces the native MyTarget showcase ad card on the home catalog with VK's EmptyVh.
Hide promoted banner content
Forces VideoDiscoverAdsDto.canShowAdBanner to false.
Remove clip ads
Disables VK Clips ad feature gates, ad configs, and SDK ad feature parameters.
Remove video ads
Disables player ad feature gates and strips server-provided instream/mobile/sport/banner ad payloads.

sources.label: Патчи Morphe для Android-клиента «VK Видео»: блокировка рекламы, фиксированное к
sources.author: Patches VK Video
patch_list: App icon colors
Recolors the adaptive launcher icon: the background plate and the glyph drawn on top of it.
Bypass security and package checks
Bypasses package verification in AuthBridge and BuildInfo to prevent profile crash and unofficial client warnings, disables dangerous app detection, and disables VPN detection.
Bypass VPN detection
Bypasses VPN and proxy detection across the application so video streaming works smoothly over VPN.
Clone app
Changes the package name to com.vk.vkvideo.morphe so VK Video can be installed side-by-side with official VK Video.
Disable telemetry
Disables MyTracker and embedded analytics trackers.
Feed ad-block
Removes MyTarget native ad cards from the recommendations list on the video page.
Fix Tracer manifest for clone
Points the OK Tracer manifest at the cloned package name, otherwise its upload thread throws IllegalStateException and takes the app down on login.
Native anti-tamper bypass
Neutralizes the signature checks in libvkcore.so and libvkmedia.so that exit the process when the APK carries a custom signing key.
Video ad-blocker
Removes video ads (pre-rolls, mid-rolls, post-rolls, and overlay ad controls), suppresses promo recommendation snippets, and disables promo popups.
Video banner ad-block
Removes the ad banner under the player - the «РЕКЛАМА» card between the comments and the recommendations title.
Video quality preference
Plays videos at the selected resolution instead of falling back to Auto adaptive bitrate, and shows that resolution in the player quality menu.
